credits.title: Flesh & Fuel
credits.overview: A lonely French trucker's routine life on the road takes an unexpected turn when he encounters a Polish driver. As feelings develop, he struggles to balance his demanding job with a chance at love, determined to make their connection work.

credits.title: Home Front
credits.overview: Burgundy, France. Solange's 60th birthday celebrations are violently interrupted by her estranged brother, Bernard. His outburst will reawaken painful memories and reveal untold stories of the Algerian War.

credits.title: School Life
credits.overview: In one of the poorest areas of Paris, a school counselor devotes herself to working with disadvantaged students, while facing challenges of her own.

credits.title: This Is Our Land
credits.overview: Pauline, a devoted and generous home help nurse, raises her two children alone, while also looking after her father, a former steelworker. Taking advantage of her popularity, the directors of an extremist political party suggest she become their candidate at the mayoral elections.

credits.title: Life after killing
credits.overview: Italian jeweller Matteo Belmonte and his wife Christine are robbed for the third time in the space of a few months.  With Christine in danger, Matteo fires two shots. credits.title: A Mother
credits.overview: Marie lives alone with her 16 year old son. She struggles to get by with this teenager who gets deeper and deeper in violence and juvenile delinquency. credits.title: Not My Type
credits.overview: Clement, a young philosophy teacher, is sent to Arras for a year. He meets Jennifer, a pretty hair stylist, and the two freely share their hearts and bodies as they try to overcome the cultural and social divide between them.

credits.title: The Accomplices
credits.overview: Returning from a romantic getaway, a CEO and his mistress do not see a bus, which, to avoid them, swerves and flips over. The couple does not stop, and silently continues on their way. The accident claims many victims, mostly children. A car was seen nearby.

credits.title: Welcome, Kaniusha
credits.overview: A teacher goes the distance to help a new student whose family is threatened with deportation.
